text: Yes, native forest was deforested here in 2025. The analysis detected a 13.5-hectare loss of tree cover within the asset, representing 3.91% of its total area. The event was observed in the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) and corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 data, which confirmed 98% of the area was forested in 2020. The Uruguayan MGAP forest map (2021) identified 13.1 hectares of the lost area as native forest, with no planted forest involved. The deforestation meets the criteria of being a later observation in the series and aligns with the reference data.
